docker run
  -d
  --name
  stackr-proxy
  --restart
  unless-stopped
  --label
  stackr.role=proxy
  --label
  stackr.spec=e89a8cba5b44fc3f
  -v
  stackr-caddy:/caddy
  -v
  /var/lib/stackr/proxy:/run/stackr-admin
  -p
  80:80
  -p
  443:443
  --add-host
  stackr:host-gateway
  -e
  XDG_DATA_HOME=/caddy/data
  -e
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/caddy/config
  -e
  DNS_API_TOKEN=cf-token
  ghcr.io/fyrmforge/stackr:1.2.3
  proxy
